should_trigger.prompt: A viral post says this new law bans end-to-end encryption. Check the actual text and tell me what is supported.
should_trigger.reason: A current consequential claim requires primary-source verification and calibrated confidence.

should_trigger.prompt: Twenty articles repeat that this model beat doctors. Trace the claim to its source and verify it.
should_trigger.reason: Repeated reporting may be circular and stronger than the underlying evidence.

should_trigger.prompt: Did the vendor really announce that this API will shut down next month? Give me links and dates.
should_trigger.reason: The user needs a current, source-backed claim with event and publication dates.

should_not_trigger.prompt: I have packet captures from an undocumented device. Reconstruct its protocol.
Review this conduct against the current moderation policy and recommend a remedy.
Summarize the paragraph I pasted without looking anything up.

quality_cases.prompt: Many articles say Vendor X's new model outperforms human experts at contract review. Verify what is actually established and give me a concise source plan.
must_show: primary-source route rather than counting articles
calibrated verdict and evidence that would change it
must_avoid: invented citations or claims of browsing not performed
treating repeated coverage as independent corroboration
